name: ZMK Input Source
description: Exposes a D-Bus method that activates a GNOME input source by its xkb id, so the ZMK layer-switching macros can select a layout idempotently. GNOME Shell offers no supported way to do this from outside: it ignores writes to org.gnome.desktop.input-sources current, and driving IBus directly moves only the mutter keymap while Shell's own state goes stale.
